sections.html: *Indicates Key Condition. This is not an exhaustive list of medical conditions.

nodes.t: Acute decrease in Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR)

nodes.d:
• Shock* (Eg. Hypovolemia, decreased cardiac output, etc.)
  • Renovascular Thrombi/Emboli
  • Hepatorenal syndromes

• Constipation*
  • Tumor (Eg. Wilms Tumor*)
  • Congenital defects (eg. Posterior Urethral valve)
  • Urolithiasis
  • Blocked foley catheter

nodes.t: Active sediment: RBC casts, dysmorphic RBCs, proteinuria

nodes.d:
• Acute Tubular Necrosis (ATN) (Eg. Severe hypotension, drugs, myoglobin)
  • Acute Interstitial Nephritis (Eg. Infections, immune mediated)
  • Tubular obstruction (Eg. Stones)

• Immune-complex deposition (IgA nephropathy*, post-infectious*, lupus)
  • Antibody mediated (anti-GBM antibodies)
    • Anti GBM/ Goodpastures
  • Pauci-immune (+ANCA)
    • Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
    • Polyarteritis Nodosa
  • Henoch Schonlein Purpura*
  • Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome*
